Hi all,

I'm trying to deploy an app on shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io> but I run into a problem to do with the audiodriver.
The app loads a .wav file and plays it through the 'play()' function of package audio. I choose this approach over the js approach as I want reactive control to pause/rewind/resume (if that's also possible with the JS approach then I'd be happy to take that as an alternative solution).

Yet, when deploying the app on shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io> I run into the following error:

Error in value[[3L]](cond) : no audio drivers are available Calls: local ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous> Execution halted

from the info here (http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/appendix.html#default-system-packages)I deduce that an audio driver is available but I can't quite figure out how to make the app connect/use it?

Any great ideas would be super welcome!

All best,

Anne

The system package that would need to be installed is likely https://packages.ubuntu.com/trusty/libportaudio-dev

So... that turned out to be much simpler than I thought.

The audio$tag can be generated through renderUI. So...

in the UI:

     uiOutput("audiotag"),

in the server:

       output$audiotag<-renderUI(tags$audio( src = "zaksinter.wav",
                                            type ="audio/wav", autoplay = T, controls = T, loop="loop"))

The .wav file needs to be uploaded inside a www folder and then it all works beautifully : )

We send an e-mail notification before suspending an account. If the subscription cycle end date is before we would take action on the suspension, however, we don't bother sending the notification. So it is likely that in your case all that usage was at the tail end of the cycle, and you will get a new set of 25 hours. If you consume that early in the cycle, you can expect to receive the notification.
